text:
claire: Quick sync — partner asks for an integrated plan: SSO (SAML), SCIM user provisioning, KMS/HSM key wrapping, and secrets manager passthrough for marketplace offer. Need to align timelines for engineering + legal.

sam: Sounds good. Two big risks: (1) KMS key policy requirements (they want customer-managed keys in HSM), (2) SCIM delta semantics — they expect group->role mapping.

claire: Can we get an engineering feasibility note by EOD Wed? Partner timeline is end of month for marketplace listing.

jin: On the KMS side: we support envelope encryption + external wrapping today. Need to confirm HSM vendor compatibility (PKCS#11 vs cloud-KMS IAM binding). Will validate with infra partner.

marta: For SCIM and SSO: partner will send SAML metadata next week. We should provide a sample SCIM payload and mapping doc. I'll draft the mapping (group -> team) and share.

angelo: FYI from partner-eng: their HSM uses a vendor-specific KMIP endpoint. We previously tested PKCS11 only. If they insist on KMIP we need a short adapter — estimate 2-3 sprint days.

sam: Legal note: marketplace listing requires a data processing addendum + KMS key escrow language if we handle backups. I'll start a short template and ping legal.

claire: Ops question — do we want to support secrets passthrough (partner stores secrets, we reference) or copy-on-create keys? Impacts audit scope.

jin: Prefer passthrough for key material (reduces surface). But that adds op complexity — we need a small proxy layer for request signing and audit logging.

marta: For SSO/SAML: we can accept both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Will include ACS and metadata endpoints. Example config to share: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://app.redwood.example">...metadata...</EntityDescriptor>
```

angelo: Partner requested SCIM bulk import for initial user sync. We should offer a /scim/v2/Users bulk endpoint (they'll POST array). We currently support single-user upserts; bulk is ~1d dev.

claire: Action items: (1) jin validate HSM vendor compatibility & adapter estimate (owner: jin) (2) angelo prototype SCIM bulk + sample payload (owner: angelo) (3) sam + legal start DPA/KMS clause (owner: sam) (4) marta draft SAML + SCIM mapping doc and example configs (owner: marta). Please update this thread with ETA.

jin: I'll have vendor compatibility note by Tue EOD.

angelo: Can prototype bulk SCIM by Tue; will attach sample curl and JSON.

sam: Legal will have DPA draft + KMS clause by Fri.

marta: Draft mapping and SAML checklist tomorrow morning.

claire: Great. Also, partner asked for a joint announcement window two weeks after listing. Keep comms team in the loop — I'll loop them once we lock timelines. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-notify: integration-branch built successfully (artifact: integrations/hsm-scim-v1). :white_check_mark:

claire: Nice, thanks infra-bot. One more: partner wants marketplace tile copy — I'll grab marketing and ops for that once we confirm integrations.

marta: Adding checklist: SAML metadata, SCIM sample, KMS policy sample, security review slot.

angelo: Quick sample for SCIM bulk payload to save time: ```json
POST /scim/v2/Users
[ {"userName":"jdoe@example.com", "displayName":"J Doe", "groups":["devs"] } ]
```

claire: Perfect. Thanks team — let's reconvene Tues 10am if needed. :calendar:
